context: Existing Powerhouse Assurance v2 ran every five minutes but all twelve registered loops initially had 0/8 stage receipts, so the meta-loop could not distinguish partial evidence from a genuinely closed loop.
root_cause: Static assurance and scheduler/runtime health existed, but canonical cron/runtime evidence was not projected into the stage-receipt contract.
Critical loops with zero fresh stage evidence stayed AMBER indefinitely instead of becoming RED.
The assurance obligation upsert initially attempted to mutate immutable payload_sha256 identity.
fix: Project only existing cron and runtime evidence into conservative stage receipts; do not fabricate outcome or learning evidence.
Critical loops with zero fresh stage evidence are RED.
Obligation updates mutate only mutable state/evidence/version fields.
prevention_rules: A running scheduler is not a closed loop.
Missing stage evidence cannot age indefinitely as ambiguous AMBER for critical loops.
Outcome and learning stay missing until their canonical authority emits proof.
Never weaken brain_obligations identity immutability to make assurance writes succeed.

production_readback.assertion: controller executed successfully and preserved incomplete loop evidence as non-green
